ProductVolumeBreachStatus.description: An open volume breach: the output model stays failed in every run until it is rebuilt or the breach is cleared (#2581).

max_rows.description: The declared `max_rows` at the newest breach.

min_rows.description: The declared `min_rows` at the newest breach.

opened_at.description: When the breach was first recorded.

partitions.description: For a `time_interval` output, the partition keys still breached. Empty means the whole output.

product.description: The product that declares the range.

rows.description: The row count of the newest breach, when it was counted.

run_id.description: The run that recorded it, when known.

cleared.description: The marker that was deleted, when one was open.

model.description: The output model whose breach marker was cleared.

was_open.description: True when a marker was open and was deleted. False when none was open, so a second call changes nothing.
